ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the majority of both lobes. A high-contrast black vertical patch is centered at the fluke's insertion point. A narrow, irregular black band follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jaggedness with pixel-amplitude variations (peaks and valleys) of 3-12 pixels extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips, which exhibit an upward convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several circular greyish pixel rings, approximately 20-40 pixels in diameter, are visible on the white ventral surface of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions are visible, including a diagonal scratch on the left lobe near the leading edge and vertical marks near the central black patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of textured, high-contrast pixels corresponding to barnacle colonization are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation patch has a highly irregular, 'feathered' border where it meets the white pigment of the lobes.
